readings.Aries: Bold moves suit you. Impulsive ones have a different outcome — know which this is. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: Your patience is remarkable. Your patience is also a place you sometimes hide. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Gemini: The information you need exists. You have to stop seeking it and let it arrive. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: The thing you're waiting for permission to need — you have it. You always have. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: Someone is asking to be celebrated. You are good at this. Do it without making it about yourself. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Virgo: You have more compassion for imperfection than your reputation suggests. Show it. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: The mirror you hold up to others reflects you too. What do you see? Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: What you are becoming is not a betrayal of who you were. It is the completion. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Sagittarius: The adventure you need does not require travel. Change the frame of what's in front of you. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Capricorn: Something you built is worth protecting. Make sure you're protecting the right parts of it. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Aquarius: The paradox you've been carrying is that you believe in human connection and maintain great distance from it. Close some. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Pisces: The boundary you need to draw will feel unkind. It isn't. It is necessary. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
First quarter: Moon and Sun are ~90° apart, so exactly half the visible disc is lit. Tides are at their weakest (neap) around now.
Mars and Jupiter are within 1° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
